_comment: Pinebook Pro: arm64-generic's layout plus a 16 MiB RWFW (partition 11). The Rockchip boot ROM loads the boot loader from sector 64, and u-boot-rockchip.bin is about 9 MiB, so it has to sit inside a partition nothing else uses. RWFW is the first partition in legacy_disk_layout.json and holds no data on this board. install-u-boot.sh checks the actual image before writing and refuses if any other partition overlaps. ROOT-A is ext4 without a journal instead of ext2: build_image labels files with security.selinux xattrs, and the WSL2 kernel's ext2 driver has no xattr support (CONFIG_EXT2_FS_XATTR is off), while its ext4 driver does. Overrides must list partitions in the parent's order (11, 2, 4, 12, 3).
